name: hub-home-live-release-proof
goal: Require signed-in Hub Home release proof to match stable live Tracker runs on the target account’s linked Macs, including a nonzero run sample.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: cj88y7 retro: deployed health and assets passed with Home at 0 working while Tracker recorded 17 live runs. aq2z6t fixed the projection; this work closes the release proof gap.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The linked-Mac scenario renders mock Home data and checks generic wording. Release smoke lacked an independent run-count comparator against the signed-in Agents card. z1x1wk owns the projection fixture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 24eaa5e82c clean snapshot: the 0, undercount and overcount fixtures all failed with “instead of rejecting”; 4 control cases passed.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Read local Tracker before and after the settled Agents summary. Require the same nonempty node/run cohort, an exact session total and at least one working agent.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The Hub release runbook now requires the scripted before/after Tracker comparator. The seven guard cases run in the Hub unit suite.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged focused Hub check passed 7 cases in a clean snapshot at 8111dba321, paired to 24eaa5e82c.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated pre-guard snapshot accepted zero working with two live runs and failed the same mismatch cases; the fix rejected zero, undercount and overcount. The real CLI also rejected a supplied zero-working summary against 17 live Tracker runs.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
